about.title: About me
about.text:
Hello Beautiful! ♡
I'm Melissa, the founder of YehMee Beauty Lounge in Delmenhorst.
With great attention to detail and a passion for beauty, I specialise in lash extensions and nail design.
My goal is to enhance your natural beauty and give you a little time out with every visit.
I look forward to seeing you! ♡
conditions.title: Booking terms
conditions.cancel.title: Cancellation
conditions.cancel.text:
Appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled free of charge up to 48 hours in advance.
After that, the €15 deposit will not be refunded.
If you don't show up without cancelling, future bookings may be restricted.
conditions.booking.title: Booking
conditions.booking.text:
Appointments can only be booked online.
Please arrive on time for your appointment.
If you can't make your appointment, please let me know in good time.
conditions.payment.title: Payment
conditions.payment.text:
A €15 deposit is required for every booking.
It is deducted from the total price.
With a YehMee gift voucher, no deposit is needed.
The remaining amount is paid on site in cash or by card.
conditions.punctuality.title: Punctuality
conditions.punctuality.text:
Please arrive on time for your appointment.
If you are more than 10–15 minutes late without letting me know, the treatment may be shortened or the appointment rescheduled.
before.title: Before your appointment
before.notes.title: Important information
before.notes.text: Please arrive on time for your appointment. Allow enough time for your treatment and let me know in good time if you are running late. I look forward to your visit! ♡
before.confirmation.title: Booking confirmation
before.confirmation.text: After booking online, you will receive a confirmation by email. Please check your booking details and make sure your contact details are correct. If you have any questions, feel free to get in touch.
before.prep.title: Lashes & nails
before.prep.text:
If possible, please come with clean lashes and no eye make-up.
For nail appointments, feel free to send me an inspiration photo of the design you'd like in advance.
before.companions.title: Companions
before.companions.text: You are welcome to bring someone with you to your appointment. Please make sure they don't disturb the treatment. Thank you for your understanding! ♡
